facts.fact: 叙述者与Ben穿过镜子回到现代：她在公寓的硬地板上醒来，忆起曾在1901年与Ben共处三天。
facts.anchor: I’m lying on a hard floor and have no idea how I got here. I vaguely remember stepping through a mirror with Ben—but through? That seems ridiculous. That’s when the déjà vu hits me. Falling through the mirror. Three days in 1901 with Ben. Trying to come home.
facts.relation: 叙述者与Ben：一同穿越时空的同伴（1901年同行者）

facts.fact: Ben 握住我的手把我扶起来，问要不要去急诊看看；我说自己没事。
facts.anchor: “Should we go to urgent care or something?” Ben takes my hand and helps me to my feet.
facts.relation: Ben：刚随叙述者从1901年穿镜归来的同伴

facts.fact: Ben 解释镜子已按他留言所托，由 Mrs. Guthrie 和 William 确保归还到我的公寓单元。
facts.anchor: “I asked Mrs. Guthrie and William in my note to make sure it was returned, to this unit specifically.”
facts.relation: Mrs. Guthrie 与 William：受 Ben 留言之托归还镜子的人；归还地点为叙述者（The Villa）的公寓单元

facts.fact: 我拿起手机，发现现实这边也过去了将近三天；Ben 在过去停留的时长与他在未来失踪的时长相等。
facts.anchor: I pick it up, cringing when I notice nearly three days have passed here as well.

facts.fact: Morgan 在我坠入镜子的次日发来消息，问我是否安好、那个人有没有回来杀我。
facts.anchor: The first message from Morgan came the day after I fell through the mirror. Haven’t heard from you in a couple days. That guy didn’t come back and kill you, did he?
facts.relation: Morgan：曾与叙述者同住的朋友（前室友）；『那个人』指叙述者公寓里的神秘男子
facts.number: the day after I fell through the mirror；a couple days

facts.fact: 有人冒充我，用我的手机回复 Morgan：忙于工作、去外地做几天研究项目。
facts.anchor: I—or more correctly someone writing as me—replied later that day. Busy with work. Out of town for a few days on a research project.
facts.relation: 冒充者：疑似那名神秘男子（Ben 称 our mystery man）；Morgan 为收信人

facts.fact: 我指出无法对外解释 Ben 的不告而别——他已经失踪两年。
facts.anchor: You can’t claim taking off without telling anyone. It’s been two years.
facts.relation: Ben：失踪两年后刚归来的对象，叙述者需替他向外界解释

facts.fact: 结尾：Ben 握住我的双肩，向我承诺一切都会没事。
facts.anchor: He takes me by the shoulders. “Everything is going to be fine. I promise.”
facts.relation: Ben：与叙述者共同编造其两年失踪说辞的同伴
